1.word_for_word: इदानीं वैराजस्य विभूतिः स-प्रपञ्चम् अनुवर्ण्यते । — Now the glory of Vairaja is described in its entirety.; यथाग्निशक्तिर्दहस्तेन दग्धोऽग्निर्दग्ध इत्युच्यते तद्वदनापीति । — Just as the power of fire is said to be burnt by the hand, so is the mouth burnt by the power of fire.; वैकुण्ठस्था वाग्वह्न्यादयस्तत्तदंशभूताश्चिन्मया नित्या एव तेषां चिद्विलासत्वात् । — The fire of speech, which is situated in the Vaikuṇṭha planets, is always part of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; जगद्वर्तिनस्त्वमी तत्तद्विभूतयो मायिका अनित्या एवेति व्यवस्थितिः । — The position is that these are the illusory and impermanent elements of the universe.; एतस्य हरेः ॥१॥ — This is the Hari.
1.translation: Now the glory of Vairaja is described in its entirety. Just as the power of fire is said to be burnt by the hand, so is the mouth burnt by the power of fire. The fire of speech, which is situated in the Vaikuṇṭha planets, is always part of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The position is that these are the illusory and impermanent elements of the universe. This is the Hari.

2.word_for_word: सर्वासूनाम् अस्मद्-आदि-प्राणानां तस्य नासे नासारन्ध्रे परमायने उत्तम-क्षेत्रे । — In His nostrils, in the nostrils of all living entities, beginning with us, He is situated in the supreme measurement of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; मोद-प्रमोदयोश् च सामान्य-विशेष-गन्धयोर् घ्राणो घ्राणेन्द्रियं परमायनम् ॥२॥ — The sense of smell is the supreme measure of pleasure and delight and of general and special smells.
2.translation: In His nostrils, in the nostrils of all living entities, beginning with us, He is situated in the supreme measurement of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The sense of smell is the supreme measure of pleasure and delight and of general and special smells.

3.word_for_word: रूपाणां तेजसां रूप-प्रकाशानां च चक्षुर् इन्द्रियम् । — The eye is the sense of the forms, the effulgence, the forms and the lights.; अक्षिणी नेत्र-गोलके । — Axillary eye-balls.; सर्वत्र षष्ठ्य्-अन्तानां प्रथमान्तं क्षेत्रं द्रष्टव्यम् । — Everywhere the first-end of the sixth-ends should be seen.; कर्णौ श्रोत्राधिष्ठाने । — The ears are in the position of the ears.; श्रोत्रम् इन्द्रियम् ॥३॥ — The ear is the sense organ.
3.translation: The eye is the sense of the forms, the effulgence, the forms and the lights. Axillary eye-balls. Everywhere the first-end of the sixth-ends should be seen. The ears are in the position of the ears. The ear is the sense organ.

4.word_for_word: तस्य गात्रं शरीरं वस्तूनां ये सारांशास् तेषां भाजनं स्थानम् । — The body of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the container and place of all the parts of the body.; अस्य त्वक्-स्पर्शस्य वायोश् चेत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the touch of the skin is the air.; सर्वस्य मेधस्य यज्ञस्य ॥४॥ — of all the sacrifices of the sacrifice.
4.translation: The body of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the container and place of all the parts of the body. This means that the touch of the skin is the air. of all the sacrifices of the sacrifice.

5.word_for_word: उद्भिज्ज-जातीनां सर्व-वृक्षाणाम् । — All the trees of the budding species.; यैर् वृक्षैर् यज्ञः सम्यक् साधितस् तेषाम् एव वा । — Or the trees with which the sacrifice was properly performed; केशा मेघानां क्षेत्रम्, पूर्वं तथोक्तेः । — The hair is the field of the clouds, as it was previously said.; श्मश्रूणि विधुताम् । — The mustache was shaved.; पाद-कर-नखानि शिलालोहानाम् इति सादृश्याद् ऊह्यम् ॥५॥ — The feet, hands and nails are made of stone and iron, and it is understood from the similarity.
5.translation: All the trees of the budding species. Or the trees with which the sacrifice was properly performed The hair is the field of the clouds, as it was previously said. The mustache was shaved. The feet, hands and nails are made of stone and iron, and it is understood from the similarity.

6.word_for_word: क्षेम-कर्मणां पालन-कर्तृणाम् । — They are the ones who maintain the welfare of the people.; विक्रमः पादन्यासो भूर्-आदि-लोकानाम् आस्पदम् आश्रयः । — Vikrama is the placement of the feet and the refuge of the earth and other worlds.; भूर्-आदि-शब्दानाम् अव्ययत्वात् षष्ठ्या लुक् । — Since the words bhūr and others are infinitives, the sixth luk.; क्षेमो लब्ध-रक्षणम् ॥६॥ — Safety is the protection obtained.
6.translation: They are the ones who maintain the welfare of the people. Vikrama is the placement of the feet and the refuge of the earth and other worlds. Since the words bhūr and others are infinitives, the sixth luk. Safety is the protection obtained.

7.word_for_word: शरणं भयाद् रक्षणम् । — Refuge is protection from fear.; सर्वेषां कामानां वरस्य वरणस्यापि हरेर् अङ्घ्रिर् आस्पदम् ॥७॥ — The feet of the Supreme Personality of Godhead are the abode of all desires and the best of all desires.
7.translation: Refuge is protection from fear. The feet of the Supreme Personality of Godhead are the abode of all desires and the best of all desires.

8.word_for_word: वीर्यस्य शुक्रस्य । — of semen and sperm.; शिश्नोऽधिष्ठानम् । — The penis is the seat.; उपस्थस् त्व् इन्द्रियम् । — The subtle is the sense.; प्रजात्य्-आनन्दः सन्तानार्थः सम्भोगस् तेन या निर्वृतिस् तापहानिस् तस्याः ॥८॥ — The joy of procreation is the desire for progeny, the satisfaction which is obtained by it is the loss of suffering.
8.translation: of semen and sperm. The penis is the seat. The subtle is the sense. The joy of procreation is the desire for progeny, the satisfaction which is obtained by it is the loss of suffering.

9.word_for_word: परिमोक्षस्य मल-त्यागस्य पायुर् इन्द्रियम् । — The air is the sense of liberation and the renunciation of impurities.; गुदः स्थानम् । — The anus is the place.; निरृतेर् अलक्ष्म्याः ॥९॥ — They are the ill-fated of Nirṛti.
9.translation: The air is the sense of liberation and the renunciation of impurities. The anus is the place. They are the ill-fated of Nirṛti.

10.word_for_word: तमसोऽज्ञानस्य । — of ignorance of darkness.; पश्चिमः पृष्ठ-भागः । — The west is the back-side.; गोत्राणां गिरीणाम् अस्थि-संघातः ॥१०॥ — The bones of the mountains of the tribes are clustered together.
10.translation: of ignorance of darkness. The west is the back-side. The bones of the mountains of the tribes are clustered together.

11.word_for_word: अव्यक्तं प्रधानम्, रसोऽन्नादि-सारः, सिन्धवः समुद्रास् तेषाम् । — The unmanifest is the chief, taste is the essence of food and other things, and the oceans are their seas.; निधनस्य लयस्य । — of the rhythm of death.; उदरं पदं स्थानं विदितं ज्ञानिभिः । — The abdomen is the place where the foot is known to the wise.; मनसोऽस्मद्-आदि-लिङ्ग-शरीरस्य ॥११॥ — of the mind, of our original being, of the body.
11.translation: The unmanifest is the chief, taste is the essence of food and other things, and the oceans are their seas. of the rhythm of death. The abdomen is the place where the foot is known to the wise. of the mind, of our original being, of the body.

12.word_for_word: तुभ्यं तव । — To you, yours.; कुमाराणां सनकादीनाम् । — of the young men, Sanaka and others.; भवस्य श्री-रुद्रस्य । — of Bhava, Sri-Rudra.; आत्मा चित्तं परम् अयनम् ॥१२॥ — The soul is the mind, the supreme moon.
12.translation: To you, yours. of the young men, Sanaka and others. of Bhava, Sri-Rudra. The soul is the mind, the supreme moon.

13.word_for_word: एवं तावत् परमेश्वराज् जातं विश्वं ततो न भिन्नम् । — Thus, the universe, which was created by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is no different from Him.; यथा कुण्डलं सुवर्णान् न पृथक् । — Just as an earring is not separate from gold.; स तु सर्व-नियन्ता सर्व-प्रकाशको नित्यम् उक्त इत्य् अर्थाद् उक्तम् । — But it is said in the sense that He is the controller of all and the illuminator of all and is eternally spoken of.; एतद् एव पुरुष-सूक्तार्थ-कथनेन द्रढयति । — This is confirmed by the statement of the meaning of the Puruṣa-sūkta.; पुरुष एवेदं सर्वम् इत्य् अस्यार्थं दर्शयति—अहं भवान् इति सार्ध-त्रिभिः । — The man shows the meaning of this by saying that this is all—I am you, with three and a half.; ते तव अग्रजा इमे सनकादयो मरीच्य्-आदयश् च ॥१३॥ — These are your elder brothers, such as Sanaka and Marichi.
13.translation: Thus, the universe, which was created by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is no different from Him. Just as an earring is not separate from gold. But it is said in the sense that He is the controller of all and the illuminator of all and is eternally spoken of. This is confirmed by the statement of the meaning of the Puruṣa-sūkta. The man shows the meaning of this by saying that this is all—I am you, with three and a half. These are your elder brothers, such as Sanaka and Marichi.

14.word_for_word: एवं तावत् परमेश्वराज् जातं विश्वं ततो न भिन्नम् । — Thus, the universe, which was created by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is no different from Him.; यथा कुण्डलं सुवर्णान् न पृथक् । — Just as an earring is not separate from gold.; २.६.१३–१६ इत्य् एतत् सार्ध-त्रिभिः पुरुष एवेदं सर्वम् इत्य् अस्यार्थं दर्शयति ॥ — 2.6.13–16 This is the meaning of the word 'puruṣa', which is the whole of the three and a half.
14.translation: Thus, the universe, which was created by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is no different from Him. Just as an earring is not separate from gold. 2.6.13–16 This is the meaning of the word 'puruṣa', which is the whole of the three and a half.

15.word_for_word: जलं च स्थलं च नभश् चौकांसि येषां ते । — They have water, land, sky and squares.; नभौकस इति सन्धिर् आर्षः ॥१४॥ — The conjunction nabhaukasa is the Arsha.; सर्वम् इदं पुरुष एव न ततः पृथग् इत्य् अर्थः ॥१५॥ — This means that all this is the Purusha and not separate from Him.
15.translation: They have water, land, sky and squares. The conjunction nabhaukasa is the Arsha. This means that all this is the Purusha and not separate from Him.

16.word_for_word: एवं तावत् परमेश्वराज् जातं विश्वं ततो न भिन्नम् । — Thus, the universe, which was created by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is no different from Him.; यथा कुण्डलं सुवर्णान् न पृथक् । — Just as an earring is not separate from gold.; स तु सर्व-नियन्ता सर्व-प्रकाशको नित्यम् उक्त इत्य् अर्थाद् उक्तम् । — But it is said in the sense that He is the controller of all and the illuminator of all and is eternally spoken of.; एतद् एव पुरुष-सूक्तार्थ-कथनेन द्रढयति । — This is confirmed by the statement of the meaning of the Puruṣa-sūkta.; पुरुष एवेदं सर्वम् इत्य् अस्यार्थं दर्शयति—अहं भवान् इति सार्ध-त्रिभिः ॥१३–१६॥ — The man shows the meaning of this by saying that this is all—I am you, along with the three and a half.13–1
16.translation: Thus, the universe, which was created by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is no different from Him. Just as an earring is not separate from gold. But it is said in the sense that He is the controller of all and the illuminator of all and is eternally spoken of. This is confirmed by the statement of the meaning of the Puruṣa-sūkta. The man shows the meaning of this by saying that this is all—I am you, along with the three and a half.13–1

17.word_for_word: एतत् स-दृष्टान्तम् आह । — This is an illustration of the same.; असौ प्राण आदित्यः असौ वा आदित्यः प्राणः इति श्रुतेः । — That is the life-force, the sun, or that the sun is the life-force, according to the scriptures.; स्व-धिष्ण्यं मण्डलं प्रकाशयन् यथा बहिश् च प्रकाशयति एवं विराड् देहं प्रकाशयन् ब्रह्माण्डम् अन्तर् बहिश् च प्रकाशयति ॥१७॥ — Just as He illuminates the sphere of His abode and illuminates the outside, so the Supreme Personality of Godhead, illuminating His body, illuminates the universe within and without.
17.translation: This is an illustration of the same. That is the life-force, the sun, or that the sun is the life-force, according to the scriptures. Just as He illuminates the sphere of His abode and illuminates the outside, so the Supreme Personality of Godhead, illuminating His body, illuminates the universe within and without.

18.word_for_word: नित्यम् उक्तत्वं दर्शयितुम् उतामृतत्वस्य इत्य् अस्यार्थम् आह—स इति । — To show that it is eternally stated, he argues that it is the meaning of immortality—he.; अभयस्येति मन्त्र-गतामृत-पद-व्याख्या । — Abhayasyeti is the explanation of the mantra-gatamrita-pada.; अन्नेनेति पदं विभक्ति-व्यत्ययेन व्याचष्टे । — The term by food is explained by the inflectional interruption.; मर्त्यं मरण-धर्मकम् अन्नं कर्म-फलं यस्माद् अत्यगाद् अतिक्रान्तवान् । — The mortal is the death-dealing food, the fruit of his actions, from which he has passed and transcended.; अतो न केवलं सर्वात्मकः, किन्त्व् अमृतत्वस्य निजानन्दस्यापीश्वर इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that He is not only all-pervading, but also God of immortality and His own bliss.; प्रपञ्चात्मकस्य कुतो नित्यम् उक्तत्वम् इत्य् आशङ्क्य तत्-परिहाराय एतावान् अस्य इत्य् अस्यार्थम् आह—महिमेति । — Doubting why the universal is eternally stated, he argues that it is so much to avoid that—that it is glorious.; प्रपञ्चात्मकस्याप्य् अमृतेशत्वम् इत्य् एष महिमा दुरत्ययोऽपारः । — This is the insurmountable glory of being the Lord of immortality even in the universe.; प्रपञ्चानभिभूतत्वाद् इति भावः ॥१८॥ — Because the world is overwhelmed, this means.
18.translation: To show that it is eternally stated, he argues that it is the meaning of immortality—he. Abhayasyeti is the explanation of the mantra-gatamrita-pada. The term by food is explained by the inflectional interruption. The mortal is the death-dealing food, the fruit of his actions, from which he has passed and transcended. This means that He is not only all-pervading, but also God of immortality and His own bliss. Doubting why the universal is eternally stated, he argues that it is so much to avoid that—that it is glorious. This is the insurmountable glory of being the Lord of immortality even in the universe. Because the world is overwhelmed, this means.

19.word_for_word: तद् एवम् ईश्वरो नित्य-मुक्त इत्य् उक्तं, तद्-आश्रितानां भूतानां बन्ध-मोक्षौ व्यवस्थया इति दर्शयन्, पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि इत्य् अस्यार्थम् आह—पादेष्व् इति । — That is why it is thus said that God is eternally liberated, and showing that the bondage and liberation of the beings who depend on Him are in order, he argues that His feet are the universal beings, meaning that He is at His feet.; तिष्ठन्त्य् अत्रेति स्थितयो भूर्-आदि-लोकास् ते पादा इव पादा अंशा यस्य, स स्थिति-पात् । — The positions of the earth and other worlds, which are called the positions of the earth and other worlds, are like the feet of the positional foot.; तस्य पादेष्व् अंश-भूतेषु लोकेषु सर्वाञ् जीवान् विदुः । — All living beings in the worlds are known to be parts of His feet.; अस्येश्वर-सम्बन्धि-त्रिपाद् अमृतं नित्य-सुखं दिवि ऊर्ध्व-लोकेषु, न त्रिलोक्याम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the nectar of the three feet of this God-related being is eternal happiness in the heavens and the upper worlds, not in the three worlds.; तद् एव त्रिपाच्-छब्दोक्तं त्रैविध्यं दर्शयन्न् आह—त्रयाणां लोकानां मूर्धा महर्-लोकस् तस्य मूर्धानस् तद्-उपरितन-लोकास् तेषु यथाक्रमम् अमृतादिकम् अधायि निहितम् ॥१९॥ — That very same, showing the threefold nature expressed by the word Tripāc, he said: The head of the three worlds is the Mahar world, and the worlds above it are the heads of the three worlds.
19.translation: That is why it is thus said that God is eternally liberated, and showing that the bondage and liberation of the beings who depend on Him are in order, he argues that His feet are the universal beings, meaning that He is at His feet. The positions of the earth and other worlds, which are called the positions of the earth and other worlds, are like the feet of the positional foot. All living beings in the worlds are known to be parts of His feet. This means that the nectar of the three feet of this God-related being is eternal happiness in the heavens and the upper worlds, not in the three worlds. That very same, showing the threefold nature expressed by the word Tripāc, he said: The head of the three worlds is the Mahar world, and the worlds above it are the heads of the three worlds.

20.word_for_word: एतद् एव वैचित्र्यम् अधिकारि-भेदेनोपपादयन् त्रिपाद्-ऊर्ध्व इत्य् अस्यार्थम् आह । — This is the peculiarity of the difference in authority, and he argues that it is above three feet.; न प्रजायन्ते पुत्रादि-रूपेणेत्य् अप्रजा नैष्ठिक-ब्रह्मचारि-वान-प्रस्थयतयस् तेषाम् आश्रमास् त्रिलोक्या बहिर् आसन्, गृह-मेधस् त्व् अन्तः । — They were not born in the form of sons or other things, so they were not born, and their āśramas were outside the three worlds, while the household sacrifices were inside.; यस्माद् अबृहद्-व्रतो ब्रह्मचर्य-व्रत-रहितः ॥२०॥ — Because of this he observed an abṛhad-vrata without celibacy.
20.translation: This is the peculiarity of the difference in authority, and he argues that it is above three feet. They were not born in the form of sons or other things, so they were not born, and their āśramas were outside the three worlds, while the household sacrifices were inside. Because of this he observed an abṛhad-vrata without celibacy.

21.word_for_word: अयं चाधिकार-भेद एकस्यैवावस्था-भेदेन न त्व् अत्यन्त-भिन्न-विषय इति दर्शयन् ततो विष्वङ् इत्य् अस्यार्थम् आह । — Showing that this difference of rights is not a very different matter by the difference of the same state, he argues that this is the meaning of the word visvaṅga.; विविधं सुष्ठु अञ्चतीति विष्वङ् पुरुषः क्षेत्र-ज्ञः सृती मार्गौ दक्षिणोत्तरौ विचक्रमे चलति स्म । — The equator, who knew the field, moved about in the direction of the paths of the universe, south and north.; कथम्भूते सृती, साशनानशने भोगापवर्ग-प्राप्ति-साधन-भूते । — How is it that creation is the means of attaining pleasure, liberation and attainment of food and drink?; अत्र हेतुत्वेन पुनर् विशेषणम् । — Here again the adjective is used as the cause.; यद्य् अतः अविद्या कर्म-रूपा एका । — If, therefore, ignorance is one of the forms of action.; विद्या च तत्-साधनोपासना-रूपान्या ॥२१॥ — Knowledge is also another form of worship for the attainment of that.
21.translation: Showing that this difference of rights is not a very different matter by the difference of the same state, he argues that this is the meaning of the word visvaṅga. The equator, who knew the field, moved about in the direction of the paths of the universe, south and north. How is it that creation is the means of attaining pleasure, liberation and attainment of food and drink? Here again the adjective is used as the cause. If, therefore, ignorance is one of the forms of action. Knowledge is also another form of worship for the attainment of that.

22.word_for_word: तद् एवं विराड् अन्तर्वर्तिनां फल-वैचित्र्यम् उक्त्वा तत्-कारणेश्वरस्य तद्-वैलक्षण्यं दर्शयितुं तस्माद् विराड् अजायत इत्य् अस्यार्थम् आह । — That is, thus, by stating the diversity of the fruits within the Cosmos, he argues that the Cosmos was born from it, in order to show the distinctiveness of the causes of the Lord.; यस्माद् अण्डं जज्ञे, तत्र च भूतेन्द्रिय-गुणात्मको विराट् च जज्ञे, स ईश्वरस् तद् विश्वं विराड् देहं द्रव्यम् अण्डं च अतिक्रान्तवान् । — From the egg from which the egg was born, and from which the cosmic manifestation of the senses and the modes of nature was born, the Supreme Personality of Godhead transcended that universe, the cosmic body, matter and the egg.; सूर्य इवेति पूर्वोक्त एव दृष्टान्तः ॥२२॥ — Like the sun is the same illustration as mentioned earlier.
22.translation: That is, thus, by stating the diversity of the fruits within the Cosmos, he argues that the Cosmos was born from it, in order to show the distinctiveness of the causes of the Lord. From the egg from which the egg was born, and from which the cosmic manifestation of the senses and the modes of nature was born, the Supreme Personality of Godhead transcended that universe, the cosmic body, matter and the egg. Like the sun is the same illustration as mentioned earlier.

23.word_for_word: नन्व् एवं पुरुष एव चेत् सर्वं तर्हि यज्ञस्य तत्-साधनानां चापृथग्भावाद् यज्ञैः पुरुषाराधनं न सिध्येद् इत्य् आशङ्क्य तत्-परिहाराय यत् पुरुषेण हविषा इत्य् आदि-मन्त्रार्थं संगृह्य दर्शयति—यदेत्य् आदिना । — If, however, everything is thus the Purusha, then, since the sacrifice and its means are separate, the worship of the Purusha cannot be accomplished by sacrifices.; अस्येति विराड्-अन्तर्यामिणः । — Asyeti is the innermost of the universe.; तस्यैव प्रकृतत्वात् । — Because it is the nature of it.; नाभौ भवं नाभ्यं तस्मात् । — I am in the navel, and therefore I am in the navel.; यज्ञस्य संभारान् साधनानि नापश्यम् ॥२३॥ — I did not find the paraphernalia and the means for the sacrifice.
23.translation: If, however, everything is thus the Purusha, then, since the sacrifice and its means are separate, the worship of the Purusha cannot be accomplished by sacrifices. Asyeti is the innermost of the universe. Because it is the nature of it. I am in the navel, and therefore I am in the navel. I did not find the paraphernalia and the means for the sacrifice.

24.word_for_word: तदा तेषु सम्भारेषु साध्येषु सत्सु पुरुषावयवैर् एते संभाराः सम्भृताः इति चतुर्थेनान्वयः । — The fourth consequence is that these vessels were filled with the male organs when they were ready to be used.; वनस्पतयो यूपाः । — The plants are the altars.; देव-यजनं यज्ञ-भूमिः । — The sacrifice of the gods is the land of sacrifice.; इदं चेति वचनाद् यज्ञार्हे स्थाने उपविष्टः कथयतीति गम्यते । — From the words “and this” it is understood that he is speaking while sitting in a place worthy of sacrifice.; बहु-गुणान्वितो वसन्तादि-कालः ॥२४॥ — Spring and other seasons are endowed with many virtues.
24.translation: The fourth consequence is that these vessels were filled with the male organs when they were ready to be used. The plants are the altars. The sacrifice of the gods is the land of sacrifice. From the words “and this” it is understood that he is speaking while sitting in a place worthy of sacrifice. Spring and other seasons are endowed with many virtues.

25.word_for_word: वस्तूनि पात्रादीनि । — Objects, containers, etc.; ओषधयो व्रीह्य्-आदयः । — Herbs, such as oats.; स्नेहा घृतादयः । — grease, butter, etc.; रसा मधुरादयः । — The juices are sweet and so on.; सुवर्णादीनि लोहानि । — gold and other iron.; मृदश् च जलं च । — Soil and water.; चातुर्होत्रं होत्रादिकं कर्म ॥२५॥ — The four-hotra is the hotra and other rituals.
25.translation: Objects, containers, etc. Herbs, such as oats. grease, butter, etc. The juices are sweet and so on. gold and other iron. Soil and water. The four-hotra is the hotra and other rituals.

26.word_for_word: नामधेयानि ज्योतिष्टोमादीनि । — The names are Jyotishtoma and others.; ऋग्-आदीनाम् उक्तत्वान् मन्त्रा इति स्वाहा-कारादयः । — Since the Rig-Veda and others are mentioned, the mantras are called Svaha-kara and others.; देवतानाम् अनुक्रम उद्देशः । — The order of the gods is the purpose.; कल्पो बौधायनादि-कर्म-पद्धति-ग्रन्थः । — The Kalpa is a book on the methods of rituals such as the Baudhayana.; अनेनाहं यक्ष्य इति संकल्पः । — This is the resolution that I will perform the sacrifice.; तन्त्रम् अनुष्ठान-प्रकारः ॥२६॥ — Tantra is the type of ritual.
26.translation: The names are Jyotishtoma and others. Since the Rig-Veda and others are mentioned, the mantras are called Svaha-kara and others. The order of the gods is the purpose. The Kalpa is a book on the methods of rituals such as the Baudhayana. This is the resolution that I will perform the sacrifice. Tantra is the type of ritual.

27.word_for_word: गतयो विष्णु-क्रमाद्याः । — The movements are the order of Vishnu.; मतयो देवत-ध्यानानि । — The opinions are the meditations of the gods.; कृतस्य भगवति समर्पणम् ॥२७॥ — The offering of the done to the Lord.
27.translation: The movements are the order of Vishnu. The opinions are the meditations of the gods. The offering of the done to the Lord.

28.word_for_word: सम्भृताः सम्पादिताः सम्भारा येन सोऽहम् । — I am the one who has prepared the equipment; तेनैव यज्ञेनैव । — By that very sacrifice.; अनेन यज्ञेन यज्ञम् अयजन्त इति मन्त्रार्थः सूचितः ॥२८॥ — By this sacrifice the meaning of the mantra is indicated that they performed the sacrifice.
28.translation: I am the one who has prepared the equipment By that very sacrifice. By this sacrifice the meaning of the mantra is indicated that they performed the sacrifice.

29.word_for_word: तेन देवा अयजन्त इत्य् अस्यार्थं स-प्रपञ्चं दर्शयति—तत इति द्वाभ्याम् । — Therefore, the fact that the gods did not sacrifice shows the meaning of this—then, by two.; व्यक्तम् इन्द्रादि-रूपेण । — manifestly in the form of Indra and others.; अव्यक्तं स्वतः । — The unmanifest itself.; अनेन पुरुषं जातम् अग्रतः इत्य् अस्यार्थो दर्शितः ॥२९॥ — This shows the meaning of this, that the Purusha was born before.
29.translation: Therefore, the fact that the gods did not sacrifice shows the meaning of this—then, by two. manifestly in the form of Indra and others. The unmanifest itself. This shows the meaning of this, that the Purusha was born before.

30.word_for_word: काले स्व-स्वावसरे ॥३०॥ — in time and in their own opportunities.
30.translation: in time and in their own opportunities.

31.word_for_word: यद् अधिष्ठानम् इत्य् एतत् प्रश्नोत्तरार्थम् उपसंहरति—नारायण इति । — What is the abode, he concludes for the sake of answering this question—Nārāyaṇa.; आहितम् अधिष्ठितम् । — Ahitam is occupied.; भगवत्त्वे हेतुः—यः स्वतोऽगुणः । — The reason for being divine—that which is in itself devoid of qualities.; सर्गादौ गृहीता मायया उरवो गुणा येन स तस्मिन् ॥३१॥ — At the beginning of creation the thighs were captured by illusion and the modes of nature were in Him.
31.translation: What is the abode, he concludes for the sake of answering this question—Nārāyaṇa. Ahitam is occupied. The reason for being divine—that which is in itself devoid of qualities. At the beginning of creation the thighs were captured by illusion and the modes of nature were in Him.

32.word_for_word: यत् परस् त्वम् इत्य् एतत् प्रश्नोत्तरं यद् उक्तं स एष भगवान् सर्वेषां मन चेश्वरः इति तद् उपसंहरति—सृजामि इति । — The answer to this question, “What is the other?” concludes that He is the Lord and the mind of all, and that He is the Lord of all—I create.; पालनं तु स्वयम् एव करोतीत्य् आह—विश्वम् इति । — He argues that it takes care of itself—the world.; पुरुष-रूपेण विष्णु-रूपेण । — In the form of a man, in the form of Vishnu.; त्रि-शक्तिर् माया, तां धरतीति तथा सः ॥३२॥ — The three-power is illusion, and that is what he calls the earth.
32.translation: The answer to this question, “What is the other?” concludes that He is the Lord and the mind of all, and that He is the Lord of all—I create. He argues that it takes care of itself—the world. In the form of a man, in the form of Vishnu. The three-power is illusion, and that is what he calls the earth.

33.word_for_word: यच् चेदं विश्वं यद्-आत्मकश् च त्वम् इत्य् एवम् आदि-सर्व-प्रश्नानां सामान्योत्तरं, यद् उक्तं वासुदेवात् परो ब्रह्मन् न चान्योऽर्थोऽस्ति तत्त्वतः इति पुरुष एवेदं सर्वम् इति श्रुत्या च यद् दृढीकृतं तद् उपसंहरति—इति इति । — Thus, the general answer to all the original questions, “What is this universe and what is You?” concludes what has been said, “O Brahman, there is no other meaning in reality beyond Vāsudeva,” and what has been confirmed by the śruti, “The Puruṣa is everything.”; सद्-असद्-आत्मकं कार्य-कारणात्मकं भाव्यं सृज्यं भगवतः सकाशाद् अन्यत् पृथङ् न भवतीत्य् अभिहितम् ॥३३॥ — It has been said that the future creation, consisting of good and evil, consisting of cause and effect, is not separate from the Supreme Lord.
33.translation: Thus, the general answer to all the original questions, “What is this universe and what is You?” concludes what has been said, “O Brahman, there is no other meaning in reality beyond Vāsudeva,” and what has been confirmed by the śruti, “The Puruṣa is everything.” It has been said that the future creation, consisting of good and evil, consisting of cause and effect, is not separate from the Supreme Lord.

34.word_for_word: यद् उक्तम् एतावत् त्वं यतो हि मे, तम् अविज्ञाय माम् ईश्वरं प्रब्रवीषि इति तद् उपपाद्योपसंहरति—न भारती इति । — What has been said so far is that you are calling me God without knowing it because it is mine, and he concludes by saying that he is not a Bharatiya.; यद् यस्मान् मे मया औत्कण्ठ्यं भक्त्य्-उद्रेकः, तद्-युक्तेन हृदा हरिर् धृतो ध्यातः । — Whatever I have been eager to do, I have meditated on the Lord with my heart fixed on Him.; अङ्ग हे नारद ! — Anga, O Narada!; अतो मे वाङ्-मन-इन्द्रियाणां वृत्तयः सत्यार्थाः, न तु मत्-प्रभावेणेत्य् अर्थः ॥३४॥ — Therefore the functions of My speech, mind and senses are truly meaningful, and not by My power, this means.
34.translation: What has been said so far is that you are calling me God without knowing it because it is mine, and he concludes by saying that he is not a Bharatiya. Whatever I have been eager to do, I have meditated on the Lord with my heart fixed on Him. Anga, O Narada! Therefore the functions of My speech, mind and senses are truly meaningful, and not by My power, this means.

35.word_for_word: अत्र स्वानुभवम् एवान्वय-व्यतिरेकाभ्यां प्रमाणयति द्वाभ्याम् । — Here he proves his own experience by two means of consequence and distinction.; सोऽहं समाम्नायादिभिः सर्वोत्कृष्टोऽपि योगम् आश्रित्यापि यत आत्मनो मम सम्भवो जन्म तम् एव न ज्ञातवान्, कृतोऽन्यस्य वार्ता । — So I, though I was the most excellent of all by the Samamna and others, and even though I resorted to yoga, did not know the very birth of myself that was possible for me, and made the news of someone else.; एतच् च तृतीय-स्कन्धे पद्मोद्भवे वक्ष्यते ॥३५॥ — This will also be described in the third section of the Padma-udbhava.
35.translation: Here he proves his own experience by two means of consequence and distinction. So I, though I was the most excellent of all by the Samamna and others, and even though I resorted to yoga, did not know the very birth of myself that was possible for me, and made the news of someone else. This will also be described in the third section of the Padma-udbhava.

36.word_for_word: तदा समीयुषां शरणागतानां भवच्-छिदं संसार-निवर्तकं सुमङ्गलं मङ्गलावहं सुसेव्यं च तस्य चरणं नतोऽस्मि । — I bow down at the feet of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the source of all good fortune and who brings good fortune to those who come to You for shelter.; ततोऽचिन्त्य-महिमत्वेन ज्ञातवान् अस्मीति कैमुत्य-न्यायेनाह—यो हीति । — Then, by the law of Kaimutya, he says, “I have known him as an inconceivable glory.”; स्व-माया-विस्तारं यः स्वयम् अपि पर्यगात् । — He who himself has gone through the expanse of his own illusion.; परि-शब्दो निषेधे । — The word pari is in the prohibition.; एतावान् इति न ज्ञातवान् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that he did not know that he was so great.; अपरे कुतो जानीयुः ? — Where should others know?; तस्य चरणं नतोऽस्मीति पूर्वेण सम्बन्धः ॥३६॥ — I bow at His feet is the relationship with the former.
36.translation: I bow down at the feet of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the source of all good fortune and who brings good fortune to those who come to You for shelter. Then, by the law of Kaimutya, he says, “I have known him as an inconceivable glory.” He who himself has gone through the expanse of his own illusion. The word pari is in the prohibition. This means that he did not know that he was so great. Where should others know? I bow at His feet is the relationship with the former.

37.word_for_word: एतत् प्रपञ्चयति—नाहम् इति द्वाभ्याम् । — This is explained by two things—I am not.; वामदेवो रुद्रः । — Vamdeva is Rudra.; यस्य ऋतां गतिं परमार्थ-स्वरूपम् । — The true path of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the ultimate goal.; किन्त्व् इदं प्रपञ्च-रूपं तस्य मायया विनिर्मितं विचक्ष्महे विद्मः । — But we know that this universe is created by His illusory energy.; तद् अप्य् आत्म-समं स्व-ज्ञानानुरूपम् एव, न तु कृत्स्नम् । — That too is equal to the Self and is in accordance with one’s own knowledge, not the whole.; मोहित-बुद्धय इत्य् अयं तद्-अज्ञाने प्रपञ्च-ज्ञाने च हेतुः ॥३७॥ — This is the cause of ignorance of that and knowledge of the world, that the intelligences are deluded.
37.translation: This is explained by two things—I am not. Vamdeva is Rudra. The true path of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the ultimate goal. But we know that this universe is created by His illusory energy. That too is equal to the Self and is in accordance with one’s own knowledge, not the whole. This is the cause of ignorance of that and knowledge of the world, that the intelligences are deluded.

38.word_for_word: ननु सर्वेऽपि तं वर्णयन्तो दृश्यन्ते तत्राह—यस्येति ॥३८॥ — Indeed, all appear to be describing Him.
38.translation: Indeed, all appear to be describing Him.

39.word_for_word: अवतार-कर्माणि संक्षेपतो दर्शयति । — It briefly shows the actions of the incarnations.; स एष आद्यो भगवान् यः पुरुषावतारः सन् सृष्ट्य्-आदि करोति । — He is the original Supreme Personality of Godhead, who, as the incarnation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, begins the creation.; आत्मात्मन्य् आत्मनात्मानम् इति । — In the Self, the Self is the Self.; कर्ता अधिकरणं साधनं कर्म च स्वयम् एवेत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the doer, the authority, the means and the action are themselves.; पुरुषावतारः सृष्ट्य्-आदीनि च कर्माणीति संक्षेपोक्तिः ॥३९॥ — The incarnation of the Purusha and the creation and other actions are briefly stated.
39.translation: It briefly shows the actions of the incarnations. He is the original Supreme Personality of Godhead, who, as the incarnation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, begins the creation. In the Self, the Self is the Self. This means that the doer, the authority, the means and the action are themselves. The incarnation of the Purusha and the creation and other actions are briefly stated.

40.word_for_word: न यं विदन्ति तत्त्वेन इत्य् उक्तं किं तत् तत्त्वम् ? — What is that essence which is said to be not known by the essence?; इत्य् अपेक्षायाम् आह—ज्ञानं केवलं सत्यं तत्त्वम् । — In expectation of this, he argues that knowledge is the only true essence.; घटाद्य्-आकार-वृत्ति-ज्ञान-व्यवच्छेदार्थं विशेषणानि । — Adjectives for distinguishing knowledge of shape, function, etc., such as pots.; विशुद्धं विषयाकार-शून्यम् । — Pure, object-form-free.; यतः प्रत्यक् सर्वान्तरम् । — Because it is directly all-pervasive.; अत एव सम्यक् सन्देहादि-रहितम् । — That is why it is perfectly free from doubt.; अवस्थितं स्थिरम् । — It’s positioned and stable.; यतो निर्गुणम् । — Because it is devoid of quality.; अनाद्य्-अन्तं जन्म-नाश-रहितम् । — It is eternal and without end, without birth or death.; यतः पूर्णम् । — Because it’s complete.; सर्वत्र हेतुः—नित्यम् अद्वयं नित्यं सर्वदा द्वैत-प्रतीति-समयेऽपि परमार्थतोऽद्वयम् इति ॥४०॥ — The reason everywhere is that He is eternally one, eternally always, even at the time of perception of duality, in the Supreme Absolute Truth.
40.translation: What is that essence which is said to be not known by the essence? In expectation of this, he argues that knowledge is the only true essence. Adjectives for distinguishing knowledge of shape, function, etc., such as pots. Pure, object-form-free. Because it is directly all-pervasive. That is why it is perfectly free from doubt. It’s positioned and stable. Because it is devoid of quality. It is eternal and without end, without birth or death. Because it’s complete. The reason everywhere is that He is eternally one, eternally always, even at the time of perception of duality, in the Supreme Absolute Truth.

41.word_for_word: अत्र विद्वद्-अनुभवं प्रमाणयति । — Here he proves the scholarly experience.; हे ऋषे नारद ! — O Rishi Narada!; प्रशान्तात्मेन्द्रियाशयाः प्रसन्न-देहेन्द्रिय-मनसो यदा भवन्ति तदा विदन्ति । — When the soul, senses and mind are at peace, the body, senses and mind are at peace, they know.; अन्यदा तद्-अज्ञाने कारणम् आह । — Other times, he gives the reason for that ignorance.; यदा तद् एव प्रकाशमानम् एवासतां तर्कैर् विप्लुतं स्यात् तदा तिरोधीयेतेति ॥४१॥ — When that very thing which is illuminating is overwhelmed by the arguments of the living entities, then it disappears.
41.translation: Here he proves the scholarly experience. O Rishi Narada! When the soul, senses and mind are at peace, the body, senses and mind are at peace, they know. Other times, he gives the reason for that ignorance. When that very thing which is illuminating is overwhelmed by the arguments of the living entities, then it disappears.

42.word_for_word: अवतारान् विस्तरेणाह—आद्य इत्य्-आदि यावद् अध्याय-समाप्ति । — He describes the incarnations in detail—from the beginning to the end of the chapter.; परस्य भूम्नः पुरुषः प्रकृति-प्रवर्तकः । — The man of the other world is the initiator of nature.; यस्य सहस्र-शीर्षा इत्य् उक्तो लीला-विग्रहः, स आद्योऽवतारः । — He is the first incarnation of the Lord, whose pastimes are called Sahasra-śīrṣa.; यद्यपि सर्वेषाम् अविशेषेणावतारत्वम् उच्यते, तथापि कालश् च स्वभावश् च सद्-असद् इति कार्य-कारणात्मिका प्रकृतिश् च एताः शक्तयः, मन-आदीनि कार्याणि, ब्रह्मादयो गुणावताराः, दक्षादयो विभूतय इति विवेक्तव्यम् । — Although all are said to be incarnations without distinction, it should be understood that time, nature, good and evil, and nature, which is the cause and effect of action, are these powers, actions such as the mind, incarnations of the modes such as Brahma, and glories such as Dakṣa.; मनो महत् तत्त्वम् । — The mind is a great element.; द्रव्यं महा-भूतानि । — Matter is the great beings.; विकारोऽहंकारः । — The transformation is ego.; गुणः सत्त्वादिः । — The quality is the essence.; विराट् समष्टि-शरीरम् । — The gigantic whole-body.; स्वराट् वैराजः । — Svarat Vairajah.; स्थास्नु स्थावरम् । — Stasnu is a stable.; चरिष्णु जङ्गमं च व्यष्टि-शरीरम् ॥४२॥ — The moving and the physical body.
42.translation: He describes the incarnations in detail—from the beginning to the end of the chapter. The man of the other world is the initiator of nature. He is the first incarnation of the Lord, whose pastimes are called Sahasra-śīrṣa. Although all are said to be incarnations without distinction, it should be understood that time, nature, good and evil, and nature, which is the cause and effect of action, are these powers, actions such as the mind, incarnations of the modes such as Brahma, and glories such as Dakṣa. The mind is a great element. Matter is the great beings. The transformation is ego. The quality is the essence. The gigantic whole-body. Svarat Vairajah. Stasnu is a stable. The moving and the physical body.

43.word_for_word: अहं ब्रह्मा । — I am Brahma.; भवो रुद्रः । — Bhava is Rudra.; यज्ञो विष्णुः । — Yajna is Vishnu.; दक्षादयो य इमे प्रजेशाः । — These are the kings of the people, such as Dakṣa.; भवद्-आदयश् च नैष्ठिकाः । — You and others are faithful.; तललोक-पालाः पातालाधिपतयः ॥४३॥ — They are the guardians of the underworld and the masters of the underworld.
43.translation: I am Brahma. Bhava is Rudra. Yajna is Vishnu. These are the kings of the people, such as Dakṣa. You and others are faithful. They are the guardians of the underworld and the masters of the underworld.

44.word_for_word: गन्धर्वादीनाम् ईशाः । — Lord of the Gandharvas and others.; यक्षादीनां नाथाः । — They are the masters of the yakshas and others.; रक्षोरगेति सन्धिर् आर्षः । — The conjunction raksharaga is the Ārṣa.; ऋषीणां पितॄणां च श्रेष्ठाः । — They are the best of the sages and the ancestors.; प्रेतादीनाम् अधीशाः ॥४४॥ — They are the masters of the dead and others.
44.translation: Lord of the Gandharvas and others. They are the masters of the yakshas and others. The conjunction raksharaga is the Ārṣa. They are the best of the sages and the ancestors. They are the masters of the dead and others.

45.word_for_word: किं बहुना, यत् किंचिद् भगवद्-आदि तत् सर्वं परम् एव तत्त्वम् इत्य् अन्वयः । — What is more, it follows that everything, beginning with the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is the Supreme Absolute Truth.; भगवद् ऐश्वर्य-युक्तम्, महस्वत् तेजो-युक्तम् । — The Lord is endowed with opulence and great splendour.; ओजः-सहसी इन्द्रिय-मनः-शक्ती तद्-युक्तम् । — Oja is the courageous power of the senses and mind.; बलं दाक्ष्यम् । — Strength is dexterity.; श्रीः शोभा, ह्रीर् अकर्म-जुगुप्सा, विभूतिः संपत्तिः, आत्मा बुद्धिस् तद्-युक्तम् । — Opulence is beauty, shame is contempt for inaction, glory is wealth, and the soul is intelligence.; अर्णो वर्णः । — Arno is a colour.; अद्भुतार्णम् आश्चर्य-वर्णम् इत्य् अर्थः । — It means a wonderful forest and a wonderful colour.; रूपम् एव स्वरूपम्, रूपवद् अस्वरूपं च यत् तत् सर्वं परं तत्त्वं तद्-विभूतिर् इत्य् अर्थः ॥४५॥ — Form itself is the form, and whatever is like form and not formless is the Supreme Being, that is, its glory, that is, the glory of that.
45.translation: What is more, it follows that everything, beginning with the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is the Supreme Absolute Truth. The Lord is endowed with opulence and great splendour. Oja is the courageous power of the senses and mind. Strength is dexterity. Opulence is beauty, shame is contempt for inaction, glory is wealth, and the soul is intelligence. Arno is a colour. It means a wonderful forest and a wonderful colour. Form itself is the form, and whatever is like form and not formless is the Supreme Being, that is, its glory, that is, the glory of that.
